snippet.title: Heave Ho 2 – Reveal Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Heave Ho 2 is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch in summer 2026!

Heave Ho 2 swings into action with online and local 4-player thrills. Give your friends a helping hand or lose your grip and send them tumbling to their doom.

Eight themed worlds of fiendish multiplayer fun await, loaded with new gameplay twists from weightless space to cookery chaos and much more.

#IndieWorld #HeaveHo2 #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch
